title: Emerging Markets Bond ETF (EMBD): Q2 2021 Commentary
description: During Q2 2021, EMBD posted a total return of +3.10%. This compares to a gain of +4.49% for the JP Morgan EMBI Global Core Index, the fund’s benchmark, over the same period.

title: ALTY: High-Yield Dividends With A Twist Of Diversification
description: The Global X Alternative Income ETF combines 4 high-yield alternative asset ETFs with a separate allocation to high-dividend infrastructure stocks.

title: Investeringsforeningen Sparinvest - Ophævelse af suspension
description: ID-Sparinvest, Filial af Sparinvest S.A., Luxembourg has announced that the suspension of trading in certain investment funds has been lifted, and the net asset values of the affected funds will be reported to Nasdaq Copenhagen.

title: Forventede udbyttesatser for regnskabsåret 2024 - Investeringsforeningen BankInvest
description: The article provides the expected dividend rates for various BankInvest investment funds for the fiscal year 2024, as well as the final dividends for 2023. The rates are expressed in Danish kroner per unit, and it is noted that the 2024 figures are preliminary and may change before the final accounts are released.
